label: Slack Receive Message
description: Fires an execution when a message lands in a Slack channel. Works through your own Slack app's Socket Mode token (paste it on the connection), or through Slack pushing events to a weft that is reachable from the internet. Filters run before anything fires, so only matching messages cost an execution. For 'every workspace that installed my app', use Slack App Messages instead.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Reading messages needs the channels:history scope, and the app must be a member of the channel.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: Pick a channel or paste its link

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.label: Contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the text contains this
inputs.description: Only fire on messages whose text contains this. Leave empty for every message.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.label: Matches pattern
inputs.placeholder: A regular expression the text must match
inputs.description: Only fire on messages whose text matches this regular expression. Leave empty for no pattern filter.

inputs.name: fromUser
inputs.label: From user
inputs.description: Only fire on messages sent by this user id. Leave empty for anyone.

inputs.name: includeBots
inputs.label: Include bot messages
inputs.description: Also fire on messages posted by bots (including this app's own). Off by default so a workflow that posts into its own channel cannot trigger itself.

inputs.name: replies
inputs.label: Thread scope
inputs.description: Which messages fire: every message, only top-level channel messages, or only replies inside threads.
